title: ononis natrix var. condensata
intro: Ononis natrix var. condensata, commonly known as  "Broad-leaved Restharrow", is a plant species within the Fabaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce pain and swelling. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a potential treatment for infections and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents present in Ononis natrix var. condensata include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
